summary: Thin, agent-driven CLI for AI image, video, speech, and 3D generation. Routes a prompt to the cheapest capable backend: Vertex AI (Gemini/Imagen/Veo, default, gcloud auth, no API key) plus opt-in fal.ai, ByteDance ModelArk, OpenAI Images, Atlas Cloud, Worder, Fish Audio, and ElevenLabs.

vertex_adc.label: Google Cloud Application Default Credentials
vertex_adc.setup: Run `nazca setup` — installs the Google Cloud SDK if missing, runs `gcloud auth application-default login`, verifies a token mints, and saves your VERTEX_PROJECT. This is the default, no-API-key path and covers every Vertex-backed model (Gemini/Imagen/Veo).

fal_key.label: fal.ai API key (FAL_KEY)
fal_key.setup: Get a key at the fal.ai dashboard, then `nazca login` (select fal.ai) or `nazca config set fal_key <key>`, or export FAL_KEY.

ark_api_key.label: ByteDance ModelArk API key (ARK_API_KEY)
ark_api_key.setup: Get a key at ark.bytepluses.com (activate the specific Seedream/Seedance model in the console first), then `nazca login` (select ByteDance ModelArk) or `nazca config set ark_api_key <key>`, or export ARK_API_KEY.

openai_api_key.label: OpenAI API key (OPENAI_API_KEY)
openai_api_key.setup: Get a key at platform.openai.com/api-keys, then `nazca login` (select OpenAI) or `nazca config set openai_api_key <key>`, or export OPENAI_API_KEY.

atlas_api_key.label: Atlas Cloud API key (ATLAS_API_KEY)
atlas_api_key.setup: Get a key at atlascloud.ai/console/api-keys, then `nazca config set atlas_api_key <key>`, or export ATLAS_API_KEY.

worder_api_key.label: Worder API key (WORDER_API_KEY)
worder_api_key.setup: Get a key at worder.com/developers, then `nazca login` (select Worder) or `nazca config set worder_api_key <key>`, or export WORDER_API_KEY.

fish_api_key.label: Fish Audio API key (FISH_API_KEY)
fish_api_key.setup: Get a key at fish.audio (account → API keys), then `nazca login` (select Fish Audio) or `nazca config set fish_api_key <key>`, or export FISH_API_KEY.

elevenlabs_api_key.label: ElevenLabs API key (ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, sent as xi-api-key header)
elevenlabs_api_key.setup: Get a key at elevenlabs.io, then `nazca login` (select ElevenLabs) or `nazca config set elevenlabs_api_key <key>`, or export ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.
